**Stable ID:** `DATA-06.05` · **Record type:** Work Package · **Workstream:** 06 Provenance, quality, bias and reproducibility

Record whether dataset construction is reproducible: published code, pinned sources, seeds and checksums.

## Deliverables

- Reproducibility-status vocabulary
- Construction-artifact fields

## Canonical artifact paths

- `schemas/provenance.schema.json`

## Source and evidence requirements

- Construction code and checksums cite their immutable locations

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Reproducibility status distinguishes published-artifacts from independently-rebuilt
- [ ] Not attempted is never reported as failed
- [ ] Validator enforces the vocabulary

## Non-goals

- Rebuilding datasets

## Tasks and subtasks

- [ ] `DATA-06.05.T1` Define fields
  - [ ] `DATA-06.05.T1.S1` Define reproducibility statuses
  - [ ] `DATA-06.05.T1.S2` Define construction-artifact pointers
- [ ] `DATA-06.05.T2` Encode and validate
  - [ ] `DATA-06.05.T2.S1` Add reproducibility fields to the provenance schema
  - [ ] `DATA-06.05.T2.S2` Add a test that rejects failed for not-attempted reconstruction
